title.zh: 授权菲律宾总统保留政府所有若干地块供菲律宾商船学院使用，为其上建筑物及通往道路的建设拨款并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Reserve Certain Parcels of Land Owned by the Philippine Government for the Use of the Philippine Merchant Marine Academy, Appropriating Funds for the Construction of Buildings Thereon and Roads Thereto, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Reserve Certain Parcels of Land Owned by the Philippine Government for the Use of the Philippine Merchant Marine Academy, Appropriating Funds for the Construction of Buildings Thereon and Roads Thereto, and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4650_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to reserve such parcel or parcels of public land as may be available and suitable for the purpose of erecting buildings and other facilities for the Philippine Merchant Marine Academy.

For the purpose of carrying out the provisions of this Act, there is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of three million five hundred thousand pesos, or so much thereof as shall be necessary, to construct the buildings, roads and other facilities for the Philippine Merchant Marine Academy.

The construction of the buildings, facilities and roads authorized hereunder shall be undertaken by the Department of Public Works and Communications in accordance with applicable laws and regulations and within a period of three years from and after the effectivity of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 9, 1966.
